_comment: Public deployment settings, baked into the page at build time. Both values are meant to be readable by anyone who opens the site: the publishable key identifies the project and nothing more, and what it is allowed to touch is decided by row-level security in the database. The service_role key is the one that must never appear here or anywhere else in this repository. SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in the environment override these, which is how a fork points at its own project.
